hook.say: They share a border, but which neighbour is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each. Trust your gut!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Germany or Poland?
questions.fact: Germany is about 14% bigger than Poland.
questions.sayAnswer: Germany! It is about fourteen percent bigger than Poland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Spain or France?
questions.fact: Mainland France is about 9% bigger than Spain.
questions.sayAnswer: France! Mainland France is about nine percent bigger than Spain.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Thailand or Myanmar?
questions.fact: Myanmar is about a third bigger than Thailand.
questions.sayAnswer: Myanmar! It is about a third bigger than Thailand.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Libya or Egypt?
questions.fact: Libya is about 75% bigger than Egypt, with far fewer people.
questions.sayAnswer: Libya! It is about seventy-five percent bigger than Egypt, with far fewer people.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Colombia or Peru?
questions.fact: Peru is about 13% bigger than Colombia.
questions.sayAnswer: Peru! It is about thirteen percent bigger than Colombia.
